modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Support press shop technician in preparatory activities

pcs.pc_description: identify and arrange the tools, equipment, consumables and input materials required for the job as per SOP and press shop technician instructions
check the input material, tools and equipment for any defects and that they are as per the required quality standards
clean the tools and pressing apparatus properly and ensure that they are free from oil, grease and dust particles
use grease to lubricate the machine, die and raw material to prevent them from rust
support the technician in checking the air pressure, Filter Regulator Lubrication (FRL) unit, hydraulic oil tank, lubrication oil tank, etc. of machine
support in setting of the pressing machine and its parameters as per the job requirements and SOP
ensure that there is no damage done to the work pieces and machine auxiliaries during loading on the machine apparatus manually or using pulleys, chains and other hoisting mechanisms
support in loading/ feeding the blanks as per specifications (in case of manual operations)

modules.module_title: Support press shop technician in pressing activities

pcs.pc_description: hold the tools and accessories required during pressing activities in the correct manner as specified by the operator using appropriate PPE
provide appropriate consumables and accessories to the technician during pressing process
unload the workpieces safely from the pressing machine and put it on right trolley/bin without any damage
support in finishing process like deburring, buffing, etc
follow safety practices recommended by organisation during the pressing process

modules.module_title: Support press shop technician in post-pressing activities

pcs.pc_description: support in checking the finished pieces as per the work instructions for product quality
support in segregating, tagging and storing the right quality pieces into Ok pieces, defective pieces which can be repaired/reworked and pieces that are beyond repair
clean the workarea properly after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
Assist in configuring auto-feeders and emergency stop systems in the press shop.
Identify and report malfunctions in safety systems such as interlocks or light curtains.
Perform visual inspection and tagging of pressed components using standard checklists.
Operate barcode or RFID tools to scan, log, and track pressing operations.
Support material and energy conservation efforts during preparation and post-processing activities.
